title: RetraQ: Manifold-Constrained Critic Guidance for Flow Policies in RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.32148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A learned critic can improve a pretrained flow-matching policy by steering sampled actions toward higher predicted value. However, even a critic that fits the behavior data well can provide misleading action gradients. Gradient components pointing away from the data-supported region are weakly constrained by behavior data and can lead guidance to exploit critic extrapolation errors. We introduce RetraQ (Retraction-based Q-guidance), which uses geometry encoded by the pretrained flow to constrain both the direction and the destination of critic guidance. A single velocity evaluation of the frozen flow defines a denoising map. RetraQ filters the critic gradient with the map's Jacobian and applies the map itself to correct the updated action. Our analysis characterizes when these operations approximate tangent filtering and retraction onto the behavior manifold. The same update guides actions at test time and provides targets for policy d

translated_title: RetraQ：强化学习中流策略的流形约束Critic引导
translated_abstract: 学习到的Critic可以通过将采样动作引导向更高的预测价值来改进预训练的流匹配策略。然而，即使是能很好拟合行为数据的Critic也可能提供误导性的动作梯度。指向数据支持区域之外的梯度分量受行为数据的约束较弱，可能导致引导过程利用Critic的外推误差。我们提出了RetraQ（基于回缩的Q引导），它利用预训练流所编码的几何结构来同时约束Critic引导的方向和终点。对冻结流进行一次速度评估即可定义一个去噪映射。RetraQ用该映射的雅可比矩阵过滤Critic梯度，并应用该映射本身来校正更新后的动作。我们的分析刻画了这些操作何时近似于切向过滤以及向行为流形上的回缩。同一更新机制既可在测试时引导动作，也可为策略训练提供目标。
tldr: RetraQ利用预训练流模型编码的几何结构（去噪映射及其雅可比矩阵）来过滤和校正Critic梯度引导，使其近似于向行为流形的切向投影和回缩，从而避免引导过程被Critic外推误差误导，有效改进强化学习中的流匹配策略。
en_tdlr: RetraQ leverages the geometry encoded by a pretrained flow (denoising map and its Jacobian) to filter and rectify critic gradient guidance, approximating tangent projection and retraction onto the behavior manifold, thereby preventing guidance from exploiting critic extrapolation errors and improving flow-matching policies in reinforcement learning.
